brief: Returns index of first match of regular expression
description: Search string value for a regular expression and return index. If not found, -1 is returned.

parameters.description: A regular expression to use for search. A regexp literal ("a+b"re) or a compile<regexp> result is already compiled; any other regexp value is compiled for this call.
parameters.name: regexp

returns.description: Zero-based index of subString or -1 if not found.
